### Living Faith
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/living-faith
Passage: James 2:26
Points:
- Genuine faith in Christ necessarily bears fruit in loving action and service.
- Paul and James agree on salvation: Paul describes legal justification, while James describes its visible proof.
- Good deeds do not earn right standing before God, but they demonstrate that faith is genuine.
- Rahab's sheltering of the spies showed that her trust in God was real and active.
- Faith without tangible deeds of obedience is as lifeless as a body without breath.
